section.title: Introduction
section.p: riscos-allocate is a command line tool for working with RISC OS Allocate request files. It displays the contents of a request, extracts it to a YAML description for editing and source control, and recreates the binary request from that description. The tool and the file format it handles are documented here.

The tool is available from the
repository on GitHub, where the source for these documents can also be found in the prminxml directory.
